comparison.objective: Feed beef cubes into a grinder using a pusher while keeping robot parts out of the guarded throat.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool pickup, food placement, axial pushing, and safety-zone avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Both cubes must pass the throat doors, no robot body may enter the guarded volume, and the robot and objects must finish clear and still for 1 second.
comparison.reason: Guarded pushing into a machine tests safe tool use and axial feed, not precision engagement around a terminal followed by bimanual depinning.
